entities.name: Rihla (The Travels of Ibn Battuta)
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Dictated by Ibn Battuta to Ibn Juzayy in 1355, this account of 73,000 miles of travel across the Islamic world and beyond is the most detailed eyewitness description of 14th-century societies from West Africa to China.
